stem.text: The diagram shows a circuit with a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $60\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance, a $20\,\text{k}\Omega$ resistor, a thermistor and a voltmeter. The resistance of the thermistor is $20\,\text{k}\Omega$.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery labelled 60 V, a resistor, a thermistor and a voltmeter labelled V, connected in one loop.

stem.text: The temperature of the thermistor decreases, and this causes its resistance to change by 50%.
After this change, what is the reading on the voltmeter?
